invariant_bindings.invariant_text: Every request MUST have a statutory due_at computed from received_at; the clock NEVER pauses for internal delays.
Every registered store holding subject data MUST attach an artifact before close; a request CANNOT close with missing stores.
Erasure requests MUST invoke the ErasureCascade; a close with kind='erasure' and no cascade artifact SHALL be rejected.
Open, artifact, and close actions MUST each emit a TamperEvidentAuditLog entry for regulator replay.
Access and portability exports MUST be delivered via a time-bound, signed URL; exports NEVER live beyond the delivery window.
